endorsements.quote: These approaches can guide critical health system decisions regarding intervention impact and support iterative user-centered design, closing the traditional gap between clinical operations and the cost and expediency of rigorous scientific evaluation.

unlisted_practices: Conduct pre-clinical silent trials of clinical decision support tools, run in the background without influencing care, before clinical deployment.
Invest in data infrastructure and integrate health information technology and biomedical informatics as the foundation of the learning health system.
Establish multidisciplinary groups including IRB members to oversee quality improvement and research, ensuring ethics, consent, and privacy standards are met while expediting rapid-cycle testing.
Integrate AI, digital health, and learning health system education into medical, nursing, and healthcare executive curricula.
Mitigate hallucinations and ensure pipeline transparency, auditability, reproducibility, and regulatory compliance when using LLMs for data extraction and harmonization.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article presenting recommendations and strategies for health systems to operationalize learning health systems in the AI era, focusing on governance, workforce development, and informatics integration.
